title: Spain: High-speed train crash kills dozens, rescue operations ongoing
summary: Two high-speed trains carrying hundreds of passengers collided south of Madrid. Spain's transport minister said one of the trains was told to continue its journey despite a "red signal" being in…

image.caption: At least two train carriages derailed and tumbled down an embankmentImage: Manu Fernandez/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: Spain to observe three days of mourning after rail collision

blocks.caption: Sanchez  was speaking after arriving at the site of Wednesday's deadly crashImage: Violeta Santos Moura/REUTERS

blocks.text: Spain will observe three days of mourning after the death of at least 68 people in a high-speed train collision on Wednesday, Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has announced.

"All of Spain is in mourning," he said from the scene of the crash in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha, adding that it was "not acceptable for a country like Spain" to suffer two such disasters in the same year.
